judd caulfield.note: Caulfield (personal) remains in Southern California and won't play Thursday versus the Devils, Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune reports. Per the NHL media site, Caulfield has also been designated a non-roster player.

ian moore.note: Head coach Joel Quenneville said Friday that Moore (lower body) is still "a ways from skating," Patrick Present of The Hockey News reports.

ryan poehling.note: Poehling (knee) is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an MCL sprain.

troy terry.note: Terry (hip) was moved from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune reports.

alex lyon.note: Lyon (upper body) had a setback in his recovery and is without a timeline to return, the team announced Thursday.

matt grzelcyk.note: Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.

conor timmins.note: Timmins (lower body) doesn't have a timeline for his return yet, according to Heather Engel of NHL.com on Tuesday.

mikael backlund.note: Backlund (upper body) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Wild, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.

jonathan huberdeau.note: Huberdeau (hip) was placed on injured reserve Monday, per Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM.

mark jankowski.note: Head coach Rod Brind'Amour said Sunday that Jankowski has ben sent back to Raleigh to have his lower-body injury assessed, Walt Ruff of the Hurricanes' official site reports.

alexander nikishin.note: Nikishin (contract dispute) is on the Hurricanes' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.

andrew mangiapane.note: Mangiapane (lower body) is likely to be available to play Friday, but he probably won't be in the lineup, CHGO Blackhawks reports.

nicolas roy.note: Roy (lower body) is expected to miss Friday's game against Tampa Bay, per Aarif Deen of Colorado Hockey Now.

georgii merkulov.note: Merkulov (undisclosed) was put on non-roster injured reserve Monday.

oskar back.note: Head coach Glen Gulutzan said Friday that Back broke his finger and will miss 4-6 weeks, Robert Tiffin of NHL.com reports.

matt duchene.note: Duchene will be out for approximately three months after undergoing surgery to repair a core injury, the team announced Monday.

john gibson.note: Gibson sustained an upper-body injury versus the Canucks on Thursday and is questionable to return to the game.

simon edvinsson.note: Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.

marco kasper.note: Kasper (upper body) has been given a week-to-week timetable for return.

mattias ekholm.note: Ekholm (undisclosed) will miss at least a week after getting injured versus the Hurricanes on Thursday, Jason Gregor of Sports 1440 Edmonton reports.

alec regula.note: Regula (undisclosed) was designated for long-term injured reserve Thursday.

matt savoie.note: Savoie (lower body) was shifted to long-term injured reserve Thursday.

frederik andersen.note: Andersen (knee) isn't expected back until "maybe" December, head coach Mike Babcock told NHL.com on Tuesday.

mattias janmark.note: Janmark (undisclosed) does not have a timetable for his return from injury.

aleksander barkov.note: Barkov (lower body) will be out for approximately 6-8 weeks, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports Tuesday.

jonah gadjovich.note: Gadjovich (upper body) is out indefinitely, the team announced Thursday.

jan jenik.note: Jenik (undisclosed) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by Los Angeles on Thursday, per Zach Dooley of LA Kings Insider.

kevin fiala.note: Fiala (lower leg fracture) is at least three weeks away from being ready to play, Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site reports Thursday.

filip gustavsson.note: Head coach John Hynes said Sunday that Gustavsson (hip) is slated to miss at least another month, Dylan Loucks of The Hockey News reports.

brock faber.note: Faber underwent a procedure to repair his fractured skull and is without a timetable to return, per Michael Russo of The Athletic.

florian xhekaj.note: Xhekaj (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, per the NHL media site.

ivan demidov.note: Demidov (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Canadiens on Tuesday, per the NHL media site.

nick bjugstad.note: Bjugstad (pectoral) was transferred to long-term injured reserve Friday, per PuckPedia.

seamus casey.note: Casey will be out of action for 6-8 weeks after undergoing a knee procedure, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports Friday.

calum ritchie.note: Ritchie (lower body) will be out of action for 4-6 weeks, the team announced Monday.

matias maccelli.note: Maccelli (lower body) will miss the next 2-4 weeks, the team announced Monday.

mathew barzal.note: Barzal (knee) will not join the Islanders for their two-game road trip, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports Thursday.

igor shesterkin.note: Shesterkin will require surgery and a lengthy rehab process to address his season-ending right knee injury, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports Sunday.

joe veleno.note: Veleno (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve Saturday, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports.

joonas korpisalo.note: Korpisalo (lower body) will miss at least four more weeks, per Elliotte Friedman of Sportsnet on Saturday.

linus ullmark.note: Ullmark (lower body) is expected to miss the next 1-2 weeks, Claire Hanna of TSN reports Thursday.

william eklund.note: Eklund had surgery to repair a torn ankle tendon and will be out 10-12 weeks, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports Thursday.

kurtis macdermid.note: MacDermid (upper body) was moved to the injured non-roster list Monday.

owen tippett.note: Tippett (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday, per the NHL media site.

rasmus ristolainen.note: Ristolainen (upper body) won't travel with the Flyers ahead of Thursday's game against the Red Wings but is closing in on a return, Charlie O'Connor of PHLY Sports reports.

travis konecny.note: Konecny (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Sunday, according to the NHL media site.

nikita grebenkin.note: Grebenkin (back) underwent successful surgery and is expected to miss at least four months.

bryan rust.note: Rust (lower body) will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Michelle Crechiolo of the Penguins' official site reports Thursday.

ben kindel.note: Kindel (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve Thursday.

justin brazeau.note: Brazeau (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Penguins on Sunday.

ryan graves.note: Graves (lower body) is out indefinitely and was placed on injured reserve Sunday.

quentin musty.note: Musty (upper body) was put on non-roster injured reserve Monday, according to Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

kyle keyser.note: Keyser (upper body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by the Sharks on Monday, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

jacob melanson.note: Melanson's upper-body injury was diagnosed Saturday as an anterior mediastinum hematoma with vascular pseudo aneurysm. He will continue to be evaluated and is out indefinitely.

ryan lindgren.note: Lindgren (upper body) was placed on injured reserve by the Kraken on Thursday and is expected to miss four to six weeks.

jake obrien.note: O'Brien (lower body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve Wednesday.

torey krug.note: Krug (ankle) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Blues on Monday, per PuckPedia.

tyler tucker.note: Tucker had arthroscopic knee surgery and will be re-assessed in six weeks, the team announced Wednesday.

yanni gourde.note: Gourde (hip) was placed on the injured non-roster list Monday.

dakota joshua.note: Joshua (abdomen) was sent to AHL Toronto on Friday for a conditioning stint.

chris tanev.note: The Maple Leafs announced Thursday that Tanev (lower body) is considered week-to-week, Mark Masters of TSN reports.

max domi.note: Domi (back) was transferred from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, per PuckPedia.

elvis merzlikins.note: Merzlikins is expected to miss 4-6 months to begin the 2026-27 regular season while recovering from a shoulder injury, per Luke Fox of Sportsnet.

john marino.note: Marino (upper body) won't play Thursday in Seattle.

michael carcone.note: Carcone (upper body) was placed on injured reserve by the Mammoth on Tuesday.

thatcher demko.note: Co-president of hockey operations Henrik Sedin said Monday that he hopes Demko (hip) will be ready to return before Christmas, Kevin Woodley of NHL.com reports.

pierre luc dubois.note: Dubois (illness) skated Wednesday in a regular jersey and appears to be on track to return to game action Saturday against the Sabres, Sammi Silber of The Hockey News reports.

logan thompson.note: Thompson won't practice Wednesday and is considered day-to-day with a lower-body injury ahead of Saturday's clash with the Sabres, Sammi Silber of The Hockey News reports.

rasmus sandin.note: Sandin (knee) was placed on long-term injured reserve Monday.

nino niederreiter.note: Niederreiter left Thursday's game versus the Stars after taking a stick up high, and there was no update on his status after the contest, Robert Tiffin of NHL.com reports.

josh morrissey.note: Morrissey (wrist) was placed on injured reserve Monday.
